page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a woodcut-style diagram of a crescent-shaped segment and a set of concentric circles sit in the right half between paragraphs; a handwritten marginal word at top right edge and a handwritten stamp/annotation at bottom are not printed text; catchword "Sphæ-" at the foot right.

main_text.p: Circulares planæ aut una linea finiuntur, ut circulus, aut pluribus ut ἀγωνια ἀχήματα, ex quorum numero est à geometris dicta σεφωνὴ, quam ὁμόκεντροι circuli delineant, & τὰ γεγωνιωμένα ut μλωίσηοι, id est, figuræ quas segmenta circulorum uelut sibi inuicem subtensa & subiuncta atq; extremis coaptata terminis efformant. Item Triquetra, Quadrata & similes figuræ, quas non rectæ, sed circulares designant & determinant lineæ.

Circulus & circus κύκλος, est figura in planicie, quam una includit linea circularis, quæ linea ambitus dicitur, in cuius medio punctum est, à quo omnes rectæ lineæ ad lineam ambitus eductæ, inter se sunt æquales. Fit Circulus lineæ rectæ uno puncto fixo, altero, cum tota linea circumacto, donec in se reuoluatur. Punctum fixum centrum circuli denotat. Alterum περιφέρεια delineat. His interclusa linea aream Circuli effingit.

Marginal handwritten word "orbiculare" at top right and handwritten annotations are not printed text.
